RoomScore: Conference Room Quality Assessment


Stop guessing why your meeting rooms have audio problems. RoomScore delivers professional acoustic measurement and AI-powered analysis in minutes—no expensive equipment or consultants required.


THE PROBLEM


"Can you repeat that?" "Is anyone else hearing an echo?" "I can't hear the room."
Bad meeting room acoustics waste time and hurt collaboration. But without data, you're guessing which rooms need help and what to fix first.


PROFESSIONAL MEASUREMENT, PHONE-BASED CONVENIENCE

Acoustic Testing – Measure reverberation (RT60) and background noise using the same physics professionals use, with quality controls to ensure reliable results
3D Room Scanning – Capture geometry with LiDAR for accurate treatment sizing and surface area calculations
AI-Powered Analysis – Get equipment fit assessment for your room size, identify acoustic issues, and discover quick fixes (powered by Anthropic Claude)
Community Benchmarks – Compare your rooms to similar spaces in the dataset
Portfolio Dashboard – Track all your rooms, identify high-risk spaces, and prioritize improvements
Optional Call Test – Join a test call from the room and walk it while your phone listens, so you can hear what the far end hears.
Export & Share – Generate professional PDF reports with measurements, analysis, and recommendations

WHO IT'S FOR


• Facilities managers auditing office portfolios
• AV integrators validating installations
• IT teams troubleshooting meeting room complaints
• Real estate teams evaluating new office spaces


WHAT YOU'LL LEARN


• Is reverberation making speech unclear?
• Is background noise bleeding into calls?
• Are equipment and room size matched correctly?
• Which quick fixes could improve quality immediately?
• What's the ROI of acoustic treatment?
• How do your rooms compare to similar spaces?


YOUR DATA POWERS BETTER ROOMS FOR EVERYONE


All measurements contribute anonymously to community benchmarks (no room names or locations). This helps set industry standards and improve equipment analysis for everyone.


REQUIREMENTS

• iPhone 12 Pro or newer, or iPad Pro with LiDAR sensor
• iOS 17+

Download RoomScore and start measuring your conference rooms.
